Ask for less on your form. Every extra field is one more reason to stop.
See how we design sites: https://ka-performancefl.com/services/web-design/?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=2026-10-20

A contact form has one job: get the first message to you. Keep three fields:
1. Name.
2. Email or phone, whichever you reply with.
3. The message.

Address, budget, company, how they found you: all of it can wait for your reply, once they've already written.

Our own contact page asks for exactly three: name, email, message.

Want a form that asks for less? Call Alex at 904-210-1071 or message us here.

The twelve-field form and the reply in the video are drawn examples, not a real business. The music is AI generated.

#GainesvilleFL #WebDesign #SmallBusiness
